Bug_Title: "equals(Object obj)" should test the argument's type
Bug_Explanation: The equals method in the MyClass class incorrectly assumes that the obj parameter will always be of type MyClass. It directly casts obj to MyClass without checking if obj is an instance of MyClass using instanceof or getClass(). This can lead to a ClassCastException when obj is not of type MyClass.
Trigger_Explanation: The test method 'testEqualsWithDifferentType' triggers the bug by passing an object of type String to the 'showBug' method of MyClass, which internally calls the equals method without checking the type of the object. This leads to a ClassCastException when the equals method attempts to cast the String object to MyClass.
